sec-bot: [alert][git-secrets] Potential secret found in CI artifacts for repo infra/helm-charts (job build-5678). Snippet looks like an AWS access key pattern (AKIA...). Flagged by leak-scan-2. Please triage.

maria (sec): On it. Marking incident SEC-213. Rahul, can you pull the artifact and confirm if this is an AWS access key or a token?

rahul (ci): pulling artifacts now. quick grep on the job output shows pattern in build logs from 2025-11-02 03:12 UTC. appears to be an AWS access key emitted by a Helm templating step that printed values.yaml.

sam (infra): If it's an AWS access key we need to revoke immediately. Note: KMS is for encryption keys only, not IAM creds. We'll rotate the IAM key and move secret into Secrets Manager/Vault. Assigning rotation to rahul.

jenna (platform): I'll block access to the artifact URL and remove the stored artifact from the CI storage. Also setting retention to stricter defaults.

maria (sec): Action plan:
1) Contain: delete artifact, revoke key, block any associated tokens.
2) Rotate: create new key/use short-lived STS role and update CI env vars to point to Vault/Secrets Manager.
3) Audit: retro scan all repos + build logs for the timeframe.
4) Post-incident: add pre-commit and server-side scanning, tighten RBAC for deploy keys.

leo (sre): removing artifact and limiting runner permissions now. I'll reduce artifact retention to 7 days.

rahul (ci): revoked access key (console): AKIAEXAMPLE -> status: deactivated. Recorded in ticket SEC-213. Created new IAM key for the service principal and stored it in vault://aws/infra/helm-service. Updated CI protected env var. Also reduced deploy-key perms to read-only for infra/helm-charts.

sam (infra): switched the infra pipeline to use assume-role + STS with short-lived credentials where possible. patching terraform module to use role_arn and update docs.

maria (sec): Running retro scan across org now. Commands I'm running:
```
# scan working copies for AWS key patterns
git ls-files | xargs -n1 -P8 grep -nE 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}' || true

# scan build logs in S3 for the last 90 days
aws s3 ls s3://ci-artifacts/infra/helm-charts/ --recursive | awk '{print $4}' | while read k; do aws s3 cp s3://ci-artifacts/$k - | grep -E 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}' && echo "FOUND: $k"; done

# run git-secrets on all repos (best-effort)
for r in $(gh repo list org --limit 200 --json name -q '.[].name'); do gh repo clone org/$r; (cd $r && git secrets --scan || true); done
```

jenna (platform): found two archived artifacts with the same pattern before the one rahul found. deleting them and notifying teams who had download ACLs.

maria (sec): Rahul, please export the suspect logs to a secure forensics bucket (restricted ACL) so we can keep an immutable copy for analysis.

rahul (ci): copied relevant logs to s3://sec-forensics/SEC-213/ (restricted, CloudTrail enabled). Note: the Helm chart templating step used `{{ .Values.someSecret }}` and a debug flag printed values. I'll remove debug prints and add masking.

sam (infra): repo remediation checklist: add git-secrets to pre-commit, enforce server-side scanning via branch protection, disable legacy deploy keys, require platform-admin approval to add deploy keys.

maria (sec): RBAC changes we need:
- Only platform-admins can create deploy keys.
- Deploy keys default to read-only.
- Service accounts get minimal permissions; move to role assumption.
- Audit log all secrets manager/KMS accesses and enable CloudTrail data events for CI artifact buckets.

jenna (platform): proposal: restrict repo->settings: create_deploy_key -> platform-admins only; protect branches to require 2 approvals for config changes; add server-side git-secrets check on push. I'll open PR to org-policy repo and link here.

leo (sre): I'll add CloudWatch alarms for suspicious git-secrets hits from CI and wire to PagerDuty for SEV-1 events. Also enabling S3 ObjectAccess logging for artifact buckets.

maria (sec): Targets: containment now (done), rotation/CI fixes within 24 hours, org policy + RBAC changes within 48 hours, postmortem doc in 24 hours. Owners: rahul - CI changes & rotation, jenna - org policy + RBAC, leo - alerting + retention, sam - IAM role changes.

sam (infra): ack.

rahul (ci): started PR to remove debug prints and add masking in job templates, will update ticket and link PR (~2h).

jenna (platform): draft PR opened for org-policy changes, assigning maria for review.

maria (sec): We've completed immediate containment: revoked key, removed artifacts, copied logs to forensics bucket, created new key in vault and updated CI. Retro scans in progress; early results show no other committed keys in active repos. Will prepare postmortem doc with timeline and action items in 24h. :lock: :clipboard:

leo (sre): +1 to postmortem. Also recommend adding automated masking for any Helm templating debug output in our standardized pipeline templates.

maria (sec): closing this Slack thread for live triage. Follow-ups will be tracked in SEC-213 and the postmortem doc. Thanks all.

sam (infra): :thumbsup:

rahul (ci): reporting progress in ticket; will ping when PR merged.

jenna (platform): will push RBAC PR to staging for rollout tomorrow.

sec-bot: [info] SEC-213 updated: status -> contained, actions assigned.
